ratings.comment: Horrible, horrible, horrible TA/prof. Full of herself, made students feel stupid, regardless of whether they were also native speakers or not. If it wasn't Mexican Spanish, it was wrong. She is impossible to please, a horrible person in general & had too high of expectations. For the love of everything holy, TAKE ANOTHER PROFESSOR OR WAIT FOR ONE

Very very difficult class. Heard from friends that other 311 classes were a breeze! I worked my butt off and only ended up with a B because I needed the retro credits. She has impossible expectations for students.

DO NOT TAKE HER CLASS. she does little to nothing to help you do well in the class. even if you ask for help, she will not correct anything on your papers and will wait for u to turn it in so she can give u a C. I've gotten A's in every spanish class I've ever taken. Avoid her at all costs.

Doesn't give clear instructions for hardly anything. Expects you to read her mind. Grades unfairly and expects you to be visiting her during office hours constantly. Gives excessive homework. Nevertheless, I feel like I did learn alot altho she is a terrible grader and even though I'm doing everything I can I probably won't get the A I deserve.

Horrible professor with ridiculous grading scale. She had ridiculous expectations that she never clearly states, but rather expects from students. She's helpful if you go to office hours but you have to put in a lot more effort than the class is worth. Avoid her if you can!
Terrible teacher.  Impossible to get a good grade.  Don't take her if you can help it.

This semester was horrific.  I'm fairly positive this was her first time teaching 311 and it showed.  The textbook we used was great, but her expectations were absolutely ridiculous and the amount of homework was insane.  There are currently no A's in at least 2 of her 3 sections.  We're taking a petition to the Spanish department head about Maria.

She was tough...I had to work hard...But this class was the BEST Spanish class I've ever taken...I worked the hardest I've ever worked in a Spanish class but I also learned THE MOST Spanish I've ever learned in a semester...HIGHLY RECOMMEND for anyone seriously interested in learning and truely understanding Spanish grammar, etc.!
She was ok...pretty much no personality though and always seemed a little pissed off. The tests are hard, but the rest of the class is pretty easy.

Maria was impersonabe at first, but after getting to know her you realize she tries to help. However, if you don't ask, she won't go out of her way to make sure you are not struggling. The tests are difficult but consistent. Not the most fun or exciting professor, kind of a bummer, but if you get used to her and ask questions you will learn.

Maria was definitely tough - the exams were nearly impossible and she's a VERY strict grader on papers - but by the middle of the semester, I knew what to expect.  She was ALWAYS available for her students - she even ran a study group for us once a week.  I definitely reccommend her to anyone who wants to learn a lot and work hard.

I didn't like her that much during the class because she wasn't the most helpful HOWEVER after seeing her around after the class had ended, I am very glad I had her. She is a very nice and perfectly willing to help you out. The tests are hard, but they are consistent and predictable. Nothing was a surprise..we knew it was going to be hard.
she is terrible teacher who doesn't clarify anything and doesn't teach you anything. You listen to music and then get hard ass exams on stuff you never went over in class.
She didn't treat everyone equally.  She had the students teach and she didn'e explain things at all.  I would never take her again.
